title_en: Merge After Toll: Toll-plaza layout and downstream congestion

assessment_en: Author-external AI semantic review covers pre-layout TeX and selected numerical claims, with no award estimate. A separate presentation review inspected all 17 pages of the current PDF.
assessment_zh: 作者外AI语义评阅覆盖排版前TeX与选定数值主张，不提供奖档判断；另有独立版面评阅检查当前PDF全部17页。
strength_en: Links payment compatibility, booth layout, merging and finite downstream storage, while retaining rejected routes and conditional conclusions.
